title: Side A 4.0.4
intro: A tidier sidebar and a proper home for your offline library

highlights.title: Offline at a glance
highlights.description: The releases-offline card now sits at the top of the Offline page instead of the sidebar

highlights.title: One profile picture
highlights.description: The sidebar copy is gone; the avatar in the top bar opens your account settings

highlights.title: Roomier sidebar
highlights.description: Navigation sits higher, clear of the window controls on macOS

highlights.title: Updates that retry
highlights.description: A download that fails no longer sits at 0 percent: the pill becomes Retry and Settings says why

title: Side A 4.0.2
intro: Updates now install themselves, plus the right shortcut keys on Windows

highlights.title: Updates install in the app
highlights.description: New releases download in the background and finish with a restart button in the top bar, so there is no trip to GitHub

highlights.title: Windows shortcut keys
highlights.description: Search shows Ctrl K instead of the Mac Command key

title: Side A 4.0.1
intro: A small patch, mostly for the Downloads page

highlights.title: Square covers
highlights.description: Release artwork in Downloads is square again instead of rounded

title: Side A 4
intro: A big one, here is what changed

highlights.title: Seamless albums
highlights.description: Tracks hand straight over to each other, so a record plays like a record instead of a queue of files

highlights.title: Liked songs
highlights.description: Tap the heart on any track to keep it, then play or shuffle the whole shelf from its own page

highlights.title: A calmer look
highlights.description: Lighter text, tidier page headers and a player bar with the clutter taken out

highlights.title: Make it yours
highlights.description: Backdrops, blurred themes and a customisation group in Settings that folds away when you are done

highlights.title: Wishlist at a glance
highlights.description: The wishlist now counts releases, artists and whatever landed this month
